claims.claim: Detector behavior changed substantially and heterogeneously under R0->R1 distribution shift at fixed operating thresholds.

criteria.CONFIRMED: Per-detector protected recall and benign FPR differ from R0 in detector-specific directions: at least two detectors move in opposite directions on recall or on FPR.
criteria.CONTRADICTED: All three detectors protected recall and FPR lie inside their frozen R0 95% intervals (no observable shift).
criteria.NOT_EVALUABLE: Protected population lacks the label classes needed or is not a distribution-shifted population.
criteria.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Detector-specific movement is observable on only one label side (attack-only or benign-only protected population).
criteria.QUALIFIED: All three detectors move in the same direction on both recall and FPR (shift present but not heterogeneous).

claims.protected_requirements: Protected population with attack and benign labels.
claims.question: RQ1

claims.claim: D_S and D_G exhibited substantial failure overlap under targeted/adaptive regimes.

criteria.CONFIRMED: More than half of protected D_S misses are also D_G misses.
criteria.CONTRADICTED: Not used: the development claim concerns adversarial regimes; a non-adversarial protected population cannot contradict it.
criteria.NOT_EVALUABLE: No protected attack positives or zero protected D_S misses (shared-miss share UNDEFINED).
criteria.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Some but at most half of protected D_S misses are also D_G misses.
criteria.QUALIFIED: Protected D_S misses exist but none is shared with D_G.

claims.protected_requirements: Protected attack-positive population with at least one D_S miss.
claims.question: RQ2

claims.claim: D_M-B remained complementary in the observed R1/R2/R3 samples (no observed miss shared with D_S or D_G).

criteria.CONFIRMED: Protected D_M-B shares no false negative with D_S or with D_G.
criteria.CONTRADICTED: At least one protected all-three miss (pattern 111) occurs.
criteria.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: D_M-B shares misses with exactly one other detector and no all-three miss occurs.
criteria.QUALIFIED: D_M-B shares misses with both other detectors pairwise but no all-three miss occurs.

claims.question: RQ2

claims.claim: No all-three common-mode failure was observed in development R1, R2-DMB, R2-D_S or R3.

criteria.CONFIRMED: Zero protected all-three false negatives (reported as an observation, never as zero risk).
criteria.CONTRADICTED: Protected all-three JFN above the frozen R0 all-three JFN 95% upper bound (0.0273).
criteria.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Not used for this binary observation.
criteria.QUALIFIED: One or more protected all-three false negatives with all-three JFN at or below the frozen R0 all-three JFN 95% upper bound (0.0273): the development observation does not generalize.

claims.question: RQ2

claims.claim: D_M-B observed attack coverage coexists with substantial benign false-positive inflation under distribution shift.

criteria.CONFIRMED: Protected D_M-B benign FPR above its R0 value (0.0609) while protected D_M-B attack recall is at least its R0 value (0.9891).
criteria.CONTRADICTED: Not used: a protected FPR cannot contradict the observed development FPR.
criteria.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Protected D_M-B benign FPR above the R0 value, attack recall below it or not evaluable.
criteria.QUALIFIED: Protected D_M-B benign FPR at or below the R0 value.

claims.question: RQ1/RQ2 caveat

claims.claim: D_G had weak R1 attack recall and high R1 benign FPR.

criteria.CONFIRMED: Protected D_G attack recall below its R0 value (0.2295) and benign FPR above its R0 value (0.0179).
criteria.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Only one of the two conditions holds.

claims.protected_requirements: Protected population with attack and benign labels.
